learning: If slalom line losses fall below 1.85 with oval finish at or above 90%, denser sensing was the slalom limit. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.32 with no max_error change, revert to five sensors.
notes: Complete robot for the seven-sensor, 12 mm pitch layout on the iteration 5 drivetrain. Only the sensor count and pitch differ from iteration 5. Outcome not yet measured.
rationale: Iteration 5 (five sensors at y=0.07 m, +/-0.036 m, 16 mm, track 0.10 m, radius 0.040 m, mass 0.5 kg; score 422.9) is the best-supported drivetrain and layout. Iteration 6 (0.4 kg) cut s-bend progress to 0.59. Iteration 7 (track 0.09 m) cut oval finish to 60%. Iteration 9 (radius 0.045 m) fell to 389.9 with oval finish 80%. Iteration 8 (+/-0.045 m spread) cut slalom line losses to 1.0 but dropped oval finish to 65%. The Builder's proposal keeps the iteration 5 drivetrain and span (+/-0.036 m) and changes only sensor count and pitch: seven sensors at 12 mm pitch, y=0.07 m, 16 mm footprint. Weights follow the same gradient as the 0.018 m scaling, x/0.018 clipped to [-2, 2], giving [-2, -1.333, -0.667, 0, 0.667, 1.333, 2]. The signal scale per metre of tape offset is unchanged from iteration 5, so kp stays at 3.5 and kd at 0.5. The controller is otherwise identical to iteration 5 (ki 0.05, base_speed 1.6, last_direction), so sensor density is the only variable. Expected, not measured: slalom line losses below 1.85 and oval finish near 95%.
